newsitem.title: USA: LPC- Huntsman Specialty gets $135 mln bank loan.
newsitem.headline: LPC- Huntsman Specialty gets $135 mln bank loan.

text.p: NEW YORK, March 11 (LPC) - Bankers Trust New York Corp on Friday began syndicating a $135 million, senior secured loan for Hunstman Specialty Chemicals, banking sources said.
Hunstman will use the 10-year bullet loan to acquire the remaining Texas chemical businesses of Texaco, they said.
The loan -- a second-lien, variable-rate credit facility -- will supplant a proposed $135 million bond offering, bankers said.

The now-defunct bond deal began a well-met roadshow last week but was pulled from the market in favor of the more-flexible loan structure. The loan facility will have a mixture of standard bank loan credit agreements and bond-like covenants, according to lenders.
Investors in the facility are expected to be senior- secured debt buyers, high-yield cross-over buyers and other high-yield investors, sources added.
The product allows Huntsman to remain a privately reporting company and gives it more flexible call provisions, sources said.

The proposed 10-year, senior subordinated notes issue would have been led by BT Securities, with DLJ Securities Corp and BancAmerica Securities, sources said. It would have allowed for no call during the first five years and would have been subject to a call premium in the 104.5-105 range thereafter, sources said.
The new facility is callable (at a premium) for the first three years, then at par through maturity, sources said.
Details on the call premium were unavailable.
